v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Benígne fac, Dómine, * in bona voluntáte tua Sion.
text.en: In thy good will, O Lord, * deal favourably with Sion.

text.la: Rectus Dóminus, * Deus noster, et non est iníquitas in eo.
text.en: The Lord our God is righteous * and there is no iniquity in him.

text.la: A timóre inimíci * éripe, Dómine, ánimam meam.
text.en: Deliver my soul, * O Lord, from the fear of the enemy.

text.la: In servis suis * miserébitur Dóminus et propítius erit terræ pópuli sui.
text.en: The Lord will judge * his servants, and will have mercy on the people of his land.

text.la: Laudáte * Dóminum secúndum multitúdinem magnitúdinis eius.
text.en: Praise ye the Lord * according to the excellence of his greatness.

text.la: Clama, ne cesses, quasi tuba exálta vocem tuam, et annúntia pópulo meo scélera eórum, et dómui Iacob peccáta eórum.
text.en: Cry, cease not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and show my people their wicked doings, and the house of Jacob their sins.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Vadam ad Patrem meum * et dicam ei: Pater, fac me sicut unum ex mercenáriis tuis.
text.en: I will arise and go to my father, * and will say unto him: Make me as one of thine hired servants.

text.la: Da, quǽsumus, Dómine, nostris efféctum ieiúniis salutárem: ut castigátio carnis assúmpta, ad nostrárum vegetatiónem tránseat animárum.
text.en: Grant, O Lord, we beseech thee, that our Fasts may bring forth their fruit unto salvation, that so the affliction which we lay upon our bodies may quicken our souls unto spiritual increase.

title.la: S. Gabrielis a Virgine Perdolente Confessoris
title.en: St. Gabriel of the Sorrowful Virgin, Confessor

text.la: Euge, serve bone et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Deus, qui beátum Gabriélem dulcíssimæ Matris tuæ dolóres assídue recólere docuísti, ac per illam sanctitátis et miraculórum glória sublimásti: da nobis, eius intercessióne et exémplo; ita Genetrícis tuæ consociári flétibus, ut matérna eiúsdem protectióne salvémur:
text.en: O God, who didst teach blessed Gabriel to ponder well the sorrows of thy gentle Mother, whereby thou didst also exalt him to the glory of holiness and mighty works: grant us, after his example, in such wise to become one with thy Mother in her sorrows; that under her kindly protection we may attain everlasting salvation.
